entities.title: Neon Snake Godot client
entities.summary: The Godot 4.7 project: one scene whose script builds everything in code, so there are no art or sound files besides the Inter font.
entities.purpose: Holds the game: scripts/main.gd (rules on a fixed tick, drawing interpolated between ticks, particles, HUD, input, layout), scripts/sfx.gd (sounds synthesised at start-up), shaders/background.gdshader, the web shell, and tests/test_game.gd.
boundaries: Uses the Compatibility renderer for WebGL 2, which has no HDR 2D glow; the bloom is drawn by hand on an additive layer.
